title: Applied production migration must have an exact source-and-provider-backed lock entry before dependent protected releases
root_cause: Original #5646 migration 20261112131500 was applied in Supabase and source file was merged, but supabase/migration-history.lock.json still reflected 826 instead of 827 applied identities. Original protected preflight rejected unrelated app PR #5644 on provider/source count mismatch.
impact: Protected downstream releases were blocked; no evidence that production database migration was missing.
fix: Append only the exact provider-applied version/name read from Supabase production to existing original migration-history.lock.json; preserve all previous 826 identities and history; do not replay DDL, create a new executor, change SQL, bypass guards or assert commercial outcomes.
prevention_rule: When an original Supabase migration is provider-applied and source-merges, update and independently verify the exact original provider-backed migration lock before dependent PR tests; report and recover drift by original migration owner.
evidence: Provider-readback at 2026-11-12T13:18:08.784Z: public supabase_migrations.schema_migrations has 827 records, exact version/name 20261112131500/original_no_publish_provider_side_effect_fence_v1 exists once
Protected app PR #5644 Required workflow #43225233943 failed on expected 827 but locked 826
Existing source supabase/migrations/20261112131500_original_no_publish_provider_side_effect_fence_v1.sql present and independently reviewed.
outcome: Source lock repair candidate pending protected Required/CodeQL and exact provider parity readback; independent app UX production release and original commercial consumer ACK remain separately due.
